Training team


Meet the training team


This training is developed and delivered by a team of experts from SciLifeLab and partner organisations. Here you can find information about the training leads, instructors, and contributors.




Training leads


Training leads are responsible for the overall development, coordination, and delivery of the training.






Training Lead1


Job title


Institution


Course contact jane.doe@example.org


Training Lead1 has extensive experience in single-cell genomics and bioinformatics, and has been involved in developing and delivering training for over 10 years.


    







John Smith


Research Scientist


SciLifeLab


Course contact john.smith@example.org


John works on computational methods for multi-omics data analysis and coordinates training activities across the programme.


  







Instructors


Instructors teach, facilitate, or otherwise contribute directly to the educational activities.






Alex Example


Bioinformatician


Karolinska Institutet


Alex develops and applies computational methods for genomics and epigenomics, with several years of experience in training researchers.


 







Contributors

title: FAQ
text:
Mock Title — Advanced Methods in Experimental Research in the Life Science




Overview Content Schedule


Information


Preparation Practicalities Team Syllabus FAQ














FAQ


Frequently asked questions


Here you will find answers to common questions about this training. If you cannot find the information you are looking for, please contact the organisers.





1.Will I receive a certificate for completing the course?



Upon satisfactory completion of the course, participants will receive a course completion certificate.





2.I need to leave earlier. Is that acceptable?



Please contact the training organisers if you need to leave before the end of the course.





3.What should I do if I become sick during the course?



Please inform the training organisers as soon as possible.





4.Do you accommodate special dietary needs?



Yes. Please provide information about dietary requirements when registering.





5.What should I do if I experience discrimination or harassment?



Please contact the training organisers or follow the relevant SciLifeLab procedures.
